english.note: Use this stronger, often disparaging expression when calling someone rude by blaming their upbringing or lack of discipline.

examples.english: You insulted your mother in front of everyone; you’re really rude.
examples.traditional: 你當住咁多人面前鬧阿媽，真係冇家教。
